facts.fact: Capital FM reports that Immaculate Kassait is the outgoing Data Commissioner after a six-year tenure at Kenya's ODPC.
facts.system: Office of the Data Protection Commissioner (ODPC)

facts.fact: The outgoing Data Commissioner says the ODPC addresses complaints, investigates alleged breaches and has issued guidance on artificial intelligence.
facts.system: Office of the Data Protection Commissioner (ODPC)

facts.fact: The outgoing Data Commissioner names ratification of the Malabo Convention as unfinished business for Kenya.
